topic: How does frequency overlap between GPS L1 and Galileo E1 impact interference mitigation in multi-GNSS receiver link budgets?
response: Frequency overlap between GPS L1 and Galileo E1 can impact interference mitigation in multi-GNSS receiver link budgets. The two signals have similar frequencies, which may cause co-channel interference. However, since they are modulated with different spreading codes (GPS C/A 1023 chips/s and Galileo E1 4096 chips/s), some degree of separation is maintained. Interference suppression techniques, such as those described in the context, can mitigate this effect.
